rule.name: SortedRangeScan
rule.message: This loop walks a sorted set or map from the start only to find the first element between a lower and an upper bound, which costs one step per element below the range. Ask the sorted collection for the range instead: subSet(low, true, high, true), tailSet(low) or ceiling(low) on a NavigableSet, subMap or ceilingKey on a NavigableMap, all logarithmic.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $bounded := function($test, $element) { $test/self::InfixExpression[@Operator = ('<', '<=', '>', '>=')] [exists(.//VariableAccess[@Name = $element])] } return //ForeachStatement [*[2][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.SortedSet')] or *[2][self::MethodCall][@MethodName = ('keySet', 'navigableKeySet', 'entrySet')][ArgumentList/@Size = 0] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.SortedMap')]]] [let $element := LocalVariableDeclaration//VariableId/@Name, $body := *[3]/(self::Block[count(*) = 1]/* | self::IfStatement) return exists($body[self::IfStatement][count(*) = 2] [*[1][self::InfixExpression][@Operator = '&&'][count(*) = 2][every $side in * satisfies $bounded($side, $element)]] [*[2]/descendant-or-self::*[self::ReturnStatement or self::BreakStatement]])]
